meta.summary: Hides open-app prompts, upsells, promoted posts, Grok; blur or hide avatars, media, quotes; counts, sidebars, footer
meta.notes:
X is mid-migration between two front ends. The rebuilt one (served to logged-out visitors on 2026-11-07, signed-in users move gradually) has NO data-testid attributes; it uses data-interaction, data-slot, href and role. The classic React app keeps data-testid. Selectors for both families sit in one option; the family that is absent matches nothing. LIVE on the rebuilt front end (logged out): app-obstruction matched 1 (dialog, backdrop and close button; no scroll lock), open-app-pill matched 2 (a[href*=launch_app_store] matches 50: every tab, like and status link, so it must stay narrow). Never hide a[data-interaction=mobile-top-bar-log-in]. SOURCE only (classic app, logged in): FreekyCreep x.com list 2026-09-27, AdGuard X filter 2025.1229, char gist 2025-02: every premium-*, promoted-*, grok-* rule. explore-link (AppTabBar_Explore_Link) is from memory, not a list. No selector exists for For you vs Following, Discover more, Today's News or Who to follow without text matching. DESKTOP (macOS Safari UA): x.com serves the rebuilt front end logged out, without data-testid, so the classic-app selectors in the desktop rules are INFERRED (hand-written fixture desktop-timeline.html): premium-card, right-column-desktop, trends-section, who-to-follow-card, counts-reply-repost, counts-like-views, dm-drawer, nav-jobs-lists, verified-ticks.

## Added 2026-11-13

**LIVE** (logged out, headless Chrome, `/elonmusk`, iPhone UA and 1440 desktop UA; both served the rebuilt app, 0 `data-testid`):

- `avatars`: `[data-post-avatar] img` 5.
- `post-media`: `article [data-slot="xds-context-menu-trigger"]` 4 (3 video players, 1 photo; it wraps the `img` or `video` and its Play button).
- `quote-posts`: `[data-slot="embedded-tweet-frame"]` 5.
- `view-counts`: `[data-engagement-action="generic"]` 5; `bookmark-share`: bookmark 5, share 5.
- `counts` (rebuilt rule): `[data-engagement-action="reply|retweet|like"] svg + span` 5 each.
- `verified-badges` (rebuilt rule): `span[role="button"][aria-label="Verified account"]` 12 (English only).
- `profile-counts`: desktop hrefs `/user/following`, `/user/verified_followers` (1 each); on the phone they are `https://m.x.com/user/following?launch_app_store=true...` (matched by the `?` forms).
- `footer-links`: `nav[aria-label="Footer"]` 1 on desktop, 0 on the phone.

**SOURCE / INFERRED** (classic app, not served logged out): `Tweet-User-Avatar`, `tweetPhoto`, `videoPlayer`, `card.wrapper`, `bookmark`, `removeBookmark` test ids and `a[href$="/analytics"]`.

**Deliberately not shipped:** the desktop `aside` "Log in or sign up" card and "See the full profile" bar. The header Log in link is 0 px wide on desktop, so those asides are the only visible way in.
